title: System Admin
description:
Astrome Technologies builds wireless communication hardware for both space and terrestrial applications. We're looking for a self-motivated system administrator who enjoys open-source tooling and wants to keep the infrastructure behind that work reliable, secure, and well documented. If you want to help others and contribute to Astrome's vision, join us.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Administer the health of all computing and networking assets, including laptops, desktops, on-premises servers, remote servers, routers, switches, and other networking equipments
* Maintain high uptime for all servers and services, with monitoring and alerting in place
* Manage Ubuntu Server deployments and Linux laptops, including provisioning, patching and lifecycle management
* Support and maintain the CI/CD infrastructure, including GitHub/GitLab and Docker/Podman-based pipelines and runners
* Administer and back up SQL databases and other production data stores
* Perform periodic security audits, manage access control, and apply hardening best practices across all systems
* Maintain secure remote access to all necessary out-of-office services (VPN, SSH, etc.)
* Automate periodic tasks, updates, and provisioning wherever possible (Bash, Python, Ansible or similar)
* Document and keep current the network topology, configurations, and IP/VLAN plans
* Create, maintain, and regularly test the backup and disaster recovery policy
* Document your work, covering reasoning, outcomes, and references, so that anyone with reasonable domain knowledge can understand and reproduce it
* Coordinate with engineering and other teams to support their IT infrastructure needs
* Coordinate with vendors to procure and repair all IT-related requirements
* Manage IT infrastructure at the second office, located about 3 km from the main office, which involves occasional travel between the two sites
* Participate in field deployments of products at customer premises
* Be available for on-call duty to respond to critical incidents and outages
* Astrome reserves the right to reassign the employee to other roles as business requirements change

**Requirements**

* Must have 2-3+ years of experience
* Qualification - BSc, B.E, B.Tech or any other related field
* A very good understanding of Linux and basics of Networking & Security is a must
* Knowledge of setting up and deploying apps in AWS, GCP, Azure or DigitalOcean
* Knowledge of LXC/LXD, Podman or Docker
* Knowledge on scripting skills in Bash and Python
* Knowledge of troubleshooting and replacing part of desktops and laptops
* Basic knowledge of HTML,CSS and JS is an added advantage
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently with minimal direction from the manager

title: Senior Systems Engineer - SuccessFactor Compensation
description:
**WHO YOU ARE**

We are looking for a Senior System Engineer to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers.
  
  
Our diverse team is growing, and we would love to talk with you, if you recognize yourself in some of the following:
  
  
• Has a passion for understanding the end-to-end Compensation and Total Rewards lifecycle, combined with solid HR domain expertise.
  
• Takes a solution-focused approach and demonstrates creativity in solving problems and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  
• Shows strong ownership, proactively drives initiatives to completion, and simplifies complex processes to achieve business outcomes.
  
• Possesses a solid understanding of SuccessFactors Compensation, system integrations, interfaces, and process development.
  
• Brings hands-on experience with SuccessFactors Compensation and Employee Central (EC) modules.
  
• Works effectively across diverse teams, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and collective success.
  
• Engages and manages stakeholders across HR, People & Culture, Global Business Operations, Data, Security, and external vendors to ensure seamless alignment between business and technology.
  
• Maintains a growth mindset and actively explores AI-driven opportunities to improve HR efficiency, reporting, and decision-making.
  
  
  
This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role is though:
  
• Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Science, Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
  
• Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring and administering SAP SuccessFactors Compensation, preferably within complex multinational HCM environments.
  
• SAP SuccessFactors’ Compensation Certification is required or highly preferred.
  
• Additional experience with and certification in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central are considered an advantage.
  
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to analyze, validate, and present compensation-related data effectively.
  
• Solid understanding of SAP SuccessFactors data architecture, interfaces, integrations, and data flows, including inbound and outbound integrations with third-party systems.
  
• Experience supporting compensation structures, merit planning cycles, long-term incentive processes, and related business operations.
  
• Ability to troubleshoot configuration, integration, and data quality issues while ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the capability to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.
  
  
The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US**

You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front-line obsessed company by ensuring that we constantly understand what our co-workers are telling us
  
  
This means that you will:
  
  
• Work within a global digital team to gather business requirements, configure, support, and enhance the SuccessFactors Compensation & Employee Central modules, while delivering effective solutions for SAP SuccessFactors integrations.
  
• Oversee and manage change requests, incidents, and enhancement activities related to SuccessFactors Compensation & Employee Central, ensuring timely resolution, system stability, and minimal impact on business operations.
  
• Collaborate closely with Global Business Operations (GBO), HR stakeholders, and country teams to review services delivered by vendors, ensuring compliance with agreed service levels, KPIs, and governance standards.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.
  
  
• We are the Digital Compensation team within Total Rewards subdomain, dedicated to ensuring seamless system for compensation for our P&C stakeholders in the Ingka digital landscape.
  
• We are committed to providing efficient and reliable services, leveraging both our existing systems and new technologies to meet the needs of our global workforce.
  
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.
  
  
We can offer you:
  
  
• Work on challenging and meaningful problems in the Compensation and HR domain, contributing to the design and evolution of future-ready processes for co-workers.
  
• Opportunity to make a global impact, influencing HR solutions across multiple countries and business units.
  
• Be part of a team of highly skilled and collaborative colleagues, with world-class expertise across diverse areas of technology.
  
• Enjoy a flexible, inclusive, and friendly work environment that supports collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

.

title: Content Systems Engineer, Technical Documentation
description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Glean is looking for a Content Systems Engineer to own the documentation experience for our connectors—the integrations that allow Glean to securely access knowledge across our customers’ systems.
  
  
Connector documentation serves technical administrators responsible for configuring access, authentication, permissions, and deployments within their organizations. Keeping this information complete and accurate across a rapidly evolving product requires more than traditional authoring. It requires scalable systems that can detect change, generate and validate content, surface risk, and prevent documentation from drifting away from the product.
  
  
In this role, you will combine technical-writing expertise with programming, information architecture, and advanced AI practices. You will build deterministic automation and agentic workflows that improve documentation freshness and accuracy while reducing repetitive manual work. You will remain accountable for the quality of the resulting customer experience—not merely for producing content.
  
  
This is an AI-first documentation role. You will use AI to analyse complex inputs, generate and transform content, identify gaps, and support maintenance at scale. You will provide the judgment, technical understanding, evaluation systems, and guardrails needed to ensure that those systems produce accurate, useful, and trustworthy results.
  
  
The systems and practices you establish for connector documentation will also help improve quality across Glean’s broader documentation set.
  
  
**You Will**

* Own the end-to-end quality, organization, and maintenance of Glean’s connector documentation.
* Develop a deep understanding of how Glean’s connectors work, including their configuration, authentication, permissions, deployment, and troubleshooting requirements.
* Build and maintain scripts, agents, and content pipelines that automate documentation creation, transformation, validation, and maintenance.
* Design reusable AI workflows that combine appropriate models, tools, product context, instructions, and human review.
* Create evaluations and guardrails for AI-generated and AI-maintained documentation, investigate failures, and improve the context, tools, prompts, and systems that shape output quality.
* Build deterministic checks that detect stale, inconsistent, incomplete, or inaccurate documentation.
* Establish an information architecture that helps technical administrators navigate complex setup and configuration flows.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, QA, Support, field teams, and customers to understand product behavior, identify documentation risks, and prioritize improvements.
* Define and track measures of documentation health, including freshness, accuracy, automated-check coverage, manual effort, and field or support complaints.
* Apply successful tools, standards, and quality systems from the connector domain to the broader Glean documentation practice.

**About You**

* Prior professional experience of 8-10 Years creating or maintaining technical documentation for a complex software product.
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, technical communication, engineering, or another relevant field.
* Demonstrated ability to independently build, debug, test, and maintain useful scripts, agents, automations, or content pipelines.
* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
* Experience with docs-as-code or software-development workflows, including Git, GitHub, command-line tools, code review, and CI/CD.
* Advanced practical experience using AI beyond one-off content generation, such as:
* Strong knowledge of technical-writing and content-design principles, including audience analysis, information architecture, task-oriented documentation, and progressive disclosure.
* The judgment to organize large amounts of ambiguous or conflicting information without producing unverified or low-quality content.
* The ability to learn a technically complex product deeply and explain how it works with authority.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product managers, QA, support teams, field teams, and other subject-matter experts.
* A customer-focused approach to evaluating documentation quality and prioritizing improvements.
* Willingness and ability to work on-site full time in Glean’s Bangalore office.
* Recent professional experience in software development, test automation, or quality assurance.
* Experience building automated tests or content-quality checks with tools such as Playwright.
* Experience documenting enterprise software, APIs, authentication systems, permissions models, integrations, or administrative workflows.
* Familiarity with API specifications and structured documentation sources, including OpenAPI.
* Experience working directly with customers or conducting structured customer research.
* Experience defining service-level objectives or other measurable standards for documentation freshness and accuracy.

**Location**
:
  
  

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

title: Systems Engineer, Tech Foundations (Jira cloud)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.
  
  
Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Systems Engineer is a hands-on builder who moves fast, delivers with quality, and uses AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day work. In this role, you will configure, maintain, and continuously improve Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, and you will own end-to-end delivery of defined projects within the Jira Data Center deprecation and transition to Jira Cloud. You will work autonomously on projects that span several components and may not be fully defined, partnering with senior engineers and your manager to shape the details. You will spot where AI and automation can reduce toil and improve reliability for the teams we serve, then build those improvements. You bring solid platform knowledge, sound technical judgment within your domain, and the curiosity to grow toward senior-level scope.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Administer Jira Cloud Software (JSW), Jira Cloud Service Management (JSM), and associated Atlassian tooling; take ownership of assigned parts of the environment to improve reliability and quality, following established configuration standards and governance
* Design and implement Jira configurations including custom workflows, issue type hierarchies, permission schemes, notification schemes, screens, and field configurations aligned with Atlassian best practices, contributing independently to designs and seeking senior review where needed
* Deliver end-to-end migration workstreams within the Jira Data Center to Cloud program, such as migrating a set of projects or a configuration domain, coordinating with stakeholders on cutover readiness
* Configure Jira Service Management projects including SLAs, custom queues, JSM Forms, approval workflows, and security schemes to support internal service delivery teams
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting using native Jira Cloud tooling; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy, and legal reasons. Support and maintain Airbnb's custom Forge applications in partnership with supporting systems engineering teams
* Support Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, and license hygiene, and contribute to security posture improvements
* Partner with business stakeholders in requirements-gathering sessions, translate needs into configuration and automation solutions, and proactively highlight issues or risks in the work
* Configure Atlassian Rovo AI agents and automation rules; evaluate trade-offs between delivery speed and long-term sustainability, and apply AI responsibly and in context
* Write and maintain automation rules using Jira's native Automation engine and JavaScript; use the Jira REST API for integrations, data imports, and custom reporting
* Support testing cycles for platform changes and migrations; write and run test scripts, track defects, and ensure a rollback plan is in place before changes ship
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) for platform-focused workstreams
* Keep system configurations, runbooks, and knowledge base articles up to date to support operational continuity and self-service
* Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to Atlassian platform incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews
* Identify and reduce technical debt over time; provide constructive input in design and configuration reviews, and help teammates learn through specific examples and timely feedback
* Participate in hiring and onboarding, delivering clear and timely feedback on candidates

**Your Expertise**

* BE/B.Tech or relevant technical degree
* 3+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, including Jira Software and Jira Service Management (Jira Cloud) in enterprise environments
* Solid working knowledge of Jira workflow design, including post functions, validators, and conditions; strong command of JQL for filters, subscriptions, dashboards, and board configuration
* Hands-on experience contributing to Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud), including project configuration migration and data integrity validation
* Experience configuring Jira Cloud native tooling for reporting and planning
* Flexible to work in USA overlapping work hours
* Hands-on experience with the Jira REST API using tools like Postman (GET/PUT/POST) for data extraction, integration, and reporting; maintaining integration touchpoints with AtlassianCloud through service account creation & management
* Familiarity with integrating Atlassian tools with identity providers such as Okta and LDAP, and with user lifecycle and license management practices
* Exposure to Atlassian Rovo or other AI/ML capabilities in the Atlassian ecosystem, with an interest in applying AI thoughtfully and ethically
* Experience building Jira Automation rules; working knowledge of JavaScript and JSON for custom automation
* Working experience with Jira Service Management, including SLA configuration, JSM Forms, custom queues, and approval workflows
* Experience writing and executing test scripts and documenting defects for platform changes or migrations
* Familiarity with Agile practices; SAFe or Scrum certification is a plus
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical work to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to deliver autonomously in a remote-first, fast-moving environment and keep stakeholders informed of progress and blockers
* Familiarity with complementary enterprise tools such as Slack, Asana, Figma, Airtable, and Miro is an advantage

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. * Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering

* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.

**Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 You build and run the revenue system: the engine tags on CRM records that make revenue measurable by engine and gate, the dashboards, the renewal and dunning automation, the quota models that must exist before any offer is made, and the growing set of agents that carry routine growth and account\-management work. Half your job is revenue operations; half is building agents on our Claude and Zoho stack, with a catalogue of skills already written and a plan for which agents come first. If only one hire happened this year it would be this one.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Instrument revenue. Engine tags on every deal within two weeks of joining; the revenue board consistent between tiles and tables; geography backfill; the deal\-valuation and pace rules encoded, not remembered.
* Automate the money loop. Renewal deals spawned at T\-90, dunning and overage alerts live inside six weeks, payment failures down by half in your first quarter.
* Model before promising. Quota\-versus\-capacity models for every seat before an offer is made; per\-seat lift reports.
* Build the agents. Own the agent build queue across growth and account management: skills, eval sets, critics, decision records, acceptance telemetry, on the Agent SDK host with the CTO.
* Keep the spine clean. CRM hygiene as a nightly automated sweep, not a quarterly cleanup; duplicate proposals, stale dates, deactivated owners, all surfaced and fixed.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Engine tag live in two weeks, dunning automation in six, payment failures down 50 percent in the first quarter.
* Every quota offered in the year was modelled first.
* Agent acceptance ledger live and read weekly by every function owner.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Four to five years in revenue operations, sales operations, business systems or analytics engineering in a B2B software company.
* Hands\-on with a CRM as a builder (Zoho preferred; Salesforce or HubSpot fine), with workflows, functions, webhooks and reporting.
* You write code: Python or JavaScript, SQL, APIs; you have shipped automations that other people relied on.
* You have built with LLM tooling (Claude, agent SDKs, MCP or similar) beyond chat, and can explain what you would never let an agent do.
* Rigour with data: you distinguish gross from net, subscription from invoice, and you check both directions before you trust a number.


**Nice to have**
* Zoho One depth: CRM, Books, Billing, Desk, Flow, Analytics.
* Experience in a partner\-led or usage\-billed business.
* Experience designing evals or QA for AI systems.


**Probably not a fit if**
* You want to be an analyst producing reports; this seat builds systems that produce them.
* You are uncomfortable owning production automation with a kill switch.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.
